model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the training loss over the number of iterations for six distinct models, as indicated by the prominently displayed legend. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to slightly beyond 140,000, with numeric tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced consistently at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, each accompanied by a corresponding lighter, noisier band of the same color in the background. All six lines share a similar trajectory, starting with a steep initial descent from a loss value above 3.4 near 0 iterations, before elbowing into a gradual, steady decline across the remainder of the x-axis. The solid blue line representing "StrmLLM (n=64)" remains the highest among the curves after the initial drop, ending at a loss of approximately 2.6 by 140,000 iterations. Tracking below it is the solid orange line for "SepLLM (n=64)", which gradually descends to approximately 2.48. The solid green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)" follows a path just below the orange one, ending near 2.46, while the solid red line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" tracks lower still, concluding at roughly 2.44. The solid dark blue line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", declines to approximately 2.42 at the end of the x-axis. Lastly, the solid purple line representing the "Vanilla" model maintains the lowest position throughout the steady decline phase, ending squarely at the 2.4 loss mark at 140,000 iterations.
